name: WinCore-Foundation
summary: WinCore Foundation: a stability + resource-awareness layer for PyTorch training on Windows: file-lock-safe checkpoint writes, safe torch.compile, CPU thread scheduling (AMD/Intel + NUMA-aware), real GPU/RAM/VRAM spec checks, multi-GPU (DDP) setup, DataLoader/VRAM/disk-cache memory management, fast mmap checkpoint loading, one-call CUDA perf tuning, gradient accumulation, training phase/ETA tracking, per-axis FP8 + experimental FP4 quantization, and background (per-layer) NaN detection.
author: FWK Multiverse
